dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.reading: Xiǎonán, zhè shì nǐ de bāo ma?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: 是。这是我的钱包和手机。
dialogue.reading: Shì. Zhè shì wǒ de qiánbāo hé shǒujī.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.reading: Nà shì nǐ de diànnǎo ma?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.reading: Bù shì, shì wǒ bàba de.
